Response Benchmark Version Benchmarks  Version  Get

put.description: Bookmark a tablet (again is fine); at most 200.

post.description:
Open your corrected copy of one of your analyses or of a corpus tablet, making it the first time:
an analysis from the model's boxes, a tablet from the model's or the scholars' (`start`).
A tablet may have several copies: `new` makes another (with an optional `title`) instead of
opening your most recently changed one.

Merge versions of a tablet into a new edition of your own (workbench, story D).

The places are worked out again here, from the versions as they are now, exactly as
GET /compare does for the same sources in the same order; `picks` chooses, place by place,
whose box to keep (or none). A copy that changed since the merge page loaded it (its
`version` differs) is refused with 409, as is a different number of places. Each box keeps
where it came from and its author, who is credited on the edition.

delete.description: Throw the copy away, with its history and shares. The analysis itself stays.

patch.description: Apply one save: add, move, resize, relabel and delete boxes. All or nothing.

get.description: Every change to the copy, newest first.

post.description: Undo one change. Refused if the box was changed again since, or the change was already undone.

get.description: The copy's newest comments (500 at most), oldest first; with box_id, only that box's thread.

get.description:
A release, with its reading: the permalink to cite. Anyone may see the releases of an edition
open to everyone; otherwise only those who can open the edition.

The Unicode Linear A character of each sign ID (null where Unicode has none).

`signs` is a comma-separated list of at most 20 distinct sign IDs, e.g. AB45,AB47,A343.

post.description: You opened this glyph: its bubble starts again from now.

The signs that look most like a sketch: a PNG of strokes on a transparent background (as a
canvas exports) or dark strokes on a light one. The sketch is redrawn with the corpus
tracings' pen and named by the reader (classifier blended with its neighbour bank).

Public, limited to 60 sketches a minute per address; the image is not stored.
One comment, saved against every listed occurrence. Each must really be this sign.

get.description:
Every corpus tablet with this sign. With ref_tablet + ref_position, ordered by similarity to that
corpus glyph; without, the most typical examples come first.

post.description:
Order the occurrences by similarity to an uploaded crop (the PNG of a detected sign).

Needs a login session: embedding holds the shared inference lock, which /analysis also uses.
The crop is embedded on the server with the same classifier as the corpus; it is not stored.

get.description:
A small picture of the sign for pickers and search results: its most typical drawing
in the corpus (from the scholars' sign boxes), or its Unicode character when the corpus
has no drawing of it. Sign IDs are matched however they are written (AB1, AB01).

post.description: Mark some of your notifications read (`ids`), or all of them.

How the server's download of the corpus data is going (admins only).

post.description:
Download the missing drawings (and transcriptions and boxes) from the corpus-v1 release
onto this server, in the background; poll GET /tablets/download. Admins only: it writes to
the server's disk. Files already present are kept.

get.description:
Your most recently changed copy of a corpus tablet, if you made one (404 otherwise).
GET /tablets/{slug}/versions lists all of them.

The tablet's boxes from the scholars' published transcription, or as the reader finds them.
The reader's need a login: reading a tablet runs the model, as an upload does (#98).

Two to six versions of a tablet side by side: their boxes matched by overlap into places,
each place marked as agreeing, differing in sign, or missing from some versions, in reading
order; and how often each pair of versions agrees. Needs a login (the model's boxes run the reader).

put.description:
Choose the tablet's accepted edition over the vote (admins). The reason (at least 15
characters) is shown to everyone with the admin's name; the votes stay visible.

post.description: Return the choice to the vote (admins), with a reason kept on record.

get.description:
The released editions of a tablet open to everyone, with their votes, the accepted one, any
admin override and its reason, and whether you may vote.
